title: 1995 South Africa Truth and Reconciliation Commission design — truth, conditional amnesty and reparation

decision_cutoff.date_or_period: 1995 before implementation of the Promotion of National Unity and Reconciliation Act
decision_cutoff.definition: South Africa's democratic transition decision whether to create a truth commission offering individual conditional amnesty for politically motivated acts on full disclosure, while documenting gross human-rights violations and creating reparation/rehabilitation mechanisms.

sources.citation: South Africa, Promotion of National Unity and Reconciliation Act 34 of 1995
sources.use_note: Primary statutory design: truth commission, amnesty criteria, victims and reparation/rehabilitation structures.

sources.citation: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of South Africa, Final Report
sources.use_note: Reveal source on implementation, findings, amnesty, victim testimony and reparation recommendations.

sources.citation: AZAPO and Others v President of the Republic of South Africa and Others, Constitutional Court, 1996
sources.use_note: Reveal/legal-review source upholding the amnesty framework while discussing transition, truth and reparations.

sources.citation: South African Government / Department of Justice materials on Truth and Reconciliation Commission
sources.use_note: Official archive of TRC structure, proceedings and records.
